trap.label: used to (produção)
trap.wrong: Residents used to queue there and the booth used to close on Friday.
trap.right: Residents used to queue there, and the booth closed on Friday.
trap.why: Em português “costumavam” e “fechou” se alternam. Em inglês, used to é só para hábito/estado antigo; fato único e recente = Past Simple.

mcq.q: Used to cannot be used with…

fix.wrong: The booth used to close on Friday.
The city used to open a new office last week.
fix.right: The city opened a new office last week.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The old booth closed. The new one opened on Monday.” (novidade)
rewrite.answer: The new one opened on Monday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to: “Residents queued every day.”
rewrite.answer: Residents used to queue every day.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no Past Simple: “The booth used to close on Friday.” (fato recente)
